ryans.name: Ryan Holiday
ryans.title: Author, The Daily Stoic; founder of Brass Check
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Holiday** (born June 16, 1987) is an American author and marketer [6]. His own biography says he dropped out of college at 19 to apprentice under Robert Greene, author of *The 48 Laws of Power* [1]. He later worked as director of marketing at American Apparel and founded the creative agency Brass Check [1].

ryans.name: Ryan (@ryangrowthh)
ryans.title: Marketer; distribution for @milesdeutscher and @aiedge_
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan**, who posts on X as **@ryangrowthh**, is a marketer based in Seattle, Washington [1]. His X bio describes him as a "marketing guy who builds big brands" and says he is "building mass distribution" for @milesdeutscher and @aiedge_ [1]. His X account was created in May 2026 [1].
known_for: Using Grok Bot for X content, about 2M views in his first two weeks on X (his figure)

ryans.name: Ryan Peterman
ryans.title: Podcaster and writer; builder of the Compose ergonomic keyboard; former Staff software engineer at Instagram
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Peterman** is a software engineer, writer and podcaster. He worked at Instagram, part of Meta, for about seven years and was promoted to Staff software engineer three years out of college [1][2][6]. He writes the newsletter *The Peterman Post*, which his site lists at more than 100,000 subscribers, and hosts *The Peterman Pod*, an interview podcast about the careers of technical people [1][12].
known_for: Reducing Instagram's basic video compute time by 94% (Meta Engineering, 2022)

ryans.name: Ryan Seacrest
ryans.title: TV and radio host
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan John Seacrest** (born December 24, 1974) is an American television and radio host and producer. As of 2025–2026 he hosts *American Idol* and *Wheel of Fortune*; he previously co-hosted *Live with Kelly and Ryan* from 2017 until April 2023 [1][2][4][5][6].
known_for: Dick Clark's New Year's Rockin' Eve

ryans.name: Ryan Shrout
ryans.title: Technology analyst and executive; president and general manager of Signal65; founder of the hardware-review site PC Perspective
ryans.lead_summary: **Ryan Shrout** is an American technology analyst and executive. He is the president and general manager of Signal65, a firm that provides performance testing and technical-marketing services, a role he took up when the company launched in December 2023 [1][3][17]. He founded the hardware-review site PC Perspective, which he owned and led until 2018, and later spent about five years at Intel, including as chief performance strategist and in client graphics and AI marketing and strategy roles [4][5][8][9].
known_for: Co-hosting This Week in Computer Hardware on TWiT
Intel client graphics and AI marketing and strategy roles
